bullets: Own the product roadmap for substantial portions of our clearinghouse offering.
Contribute to a team that ships day in and day out – see our blog and changelog
Report directly to the Head of Product and Engineering and work closely with the CEO to develop product direction.
Be the primary author of complex, technical product and business documents (e.g. PR/FAQs, BRDs, GitHub tickets). Work with our healthcare customers to gather feedback and…
Work with our design team to develop mockups and wireframes, and our engineering team to prioritize and deliver features.
